final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT c.gender, COUNT(*) as count FROM Invoices i JOIN Orders o ON i.order_id = o.order_id JOIN Customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.gender), step2 AS (SELECT SUM(count) as total FROM step1), step3 AS (SELECT gender, count, CAST(count AS REAL) / total as ratio FROM step1, step2 WHERE step2.total IS NOT NULL), step4 AS (SELECT AVG(ratio) as avg_ratio FROM step3), step5 AS (SELECT gender, count, ratio, ratio - (SELECT avg_ratio FROM step4) as difference FROM step3 WHERE ratio > (SELECT avg_ratio FROM step4)) SELECT gender, count, ratio, difference FROM step5
